runner_requirement.reason: Dependency Review v5 uses Node 24; use a current GitHub-hosted runner or verify this minimum on self-hosted runners.

osv_scanner_cli.note: The CLI's go.mod minimum supersedes its older installation guide.

osv_scanner_action.note: The CLI's v2.7.1 release does not imply an action v2.7.1 tag.

osv_source_json_contract.validation: Actual Linux binary, isolated requirements fixture and synthetic local OSV database; no project dependencies installed.
osv_source_json_contract.findings: Exit 1 retains package identity, advisory groups, affected-package records and CVSS vectors.
osv_source_json_contract.no_findings: Exit 0 defaults to an empty results array; --all-packages retains package identities but omits their vulnerabilities field.
osv_source_json_contract.network_limit: Online scan exited 127 because api.osv.dev/deps.dev could not resolve from the validation host; offline output-shape checks do not establish live service availability.

artifact_verifier_contract.cosign_result: Real supplied-root verification succeeded; wrong signer, issuer and expected digest were rejected.
artifact_verifier_contract.root_trust_boundary: Pinned official repository plus targets.json hash checked out of band; not an independent cryptographic TUF bootstrap.
artifact_verifier_contract.slsa_result: Published v0.2 and upstream v1 statement layouts checked; live positive provenance verification blocked by public TUF DNS. Mocked parser cases are not a live trust-verification result.
artifact_verifier_contract.network_limit: Public trust lookup could not resolve tuf-repo-cdn.sigstore.dev on the validation host.

remote_and_governance_contract.public_archive_result: Actual unauthenticated GitHub commit lookup and codeload extraction succeeded; missing scanner remained unknown/INCOMPLETE rather than a clean scan.
remote_and_governance_contract.governance_result: Actual read-only exact-branch rules and stable-release/activity acquisition worked; HTTP403 legacy protection and unavailable bypass details remained partial/unscored. No settings changed.
remote_and_governance_contract.image_command: OSV 2.7.1 scan image flag syntax checked against the installed official binary; Docker-backed image execution was not run.

fourth_wave_network_recheck.limitation: DNS recheck only; no endpoint substitution or trust bypass. Earlier public TUF and online OSV live-validation blockers remain.

local_inventory_and_schema_contract.syft_result: Real checksum-verified Linux binary generated source and already-built synthetic tgz inventories. Artifact subject checksum matched; missing purls/dependency edges remained explicit partial evidence.
local_inventory_and_schema_contract.spdx_result: Generated SPDX 2.3 accepted by pinned official schema; missing required field rejected. Format validation is not completeness, truth or downstream interoperability.
local_inventory_and_schema_contract.security_insights_result: Real isolated CUE accepted released-schema synthetic JSON/YAML and rejected a missing required field. Claims remain self-report.

registry_discovery_contract.npm_result: Exact-version metadata and two DSSE attestations discovered; subject digests matched registry integrity metadata.
registry_discovery_contract.pypi_result: Separate sampleproject-4.0.0 wheel and sdist SHA256 metadata and Integrity API attestations discovered; both subject digests matched registry metadata.
registry_discovery_contract.limitation: Public metadata GETs only; no package download/install or cryptographic attestation verification. Successful discovery did not raise risk scores or remove INCOMPLETE.

forbidden_refs.reason: OSV Scanner uses reusable job-level workflow paths, not this action ref.
v2.7.1 is a CLI release; the latest verified reusable workflow action is v2.7.0.
v2.4.0 references a retired GCR image; use v2.5.0 or later.
